description: This file defines a custom subclass of JMenuItem used for creating menu items in a Swing-based GUI. It provides constructors to initialize menu items with text, actions, mnemonics, and accelerators.

classes.name: MenuItem
classes.description: A custom subclass of JMenuItem that simplifies creation of menu items with optional mnemonics and accelerators.

methods.name: MenuItem(String text, Action action)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a MenuItem with specified text and action.

methods.name: MenuItem(String text, Action action, int mnemonic)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a MenuItem with specified text, action, and mnemonic key.

methods.name: MenuItem(String text, Action action, int mnemonic, KeyStroke accelerator)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a MenuItem with specified text, action, mnemonic, and keyboard accelerator.
